title: Tab with Next.js App Router
description: Tabs whose selection lives in the URL with the Next.js App Router: each Tab renders a Next.js Link, Tabs reads selectedId from usePathname and calls router.push on change, and a single TabPanel shows server-rendered posts from a parallel @tabs route while the layout stays mounted. Use it when tabs must survive reloads, shared links, and Back and Forward navigation, rather than keeping the selected tab in local state.
